title: Grateful Dead Live at Greek Theatre, Univ. of California on 1982-05-23
lineage: Cassette Master (Nakamichi DR-1/Dolby B) -> Sound Devices 744T (24bit/48k) -> Adobe Audition v3.0 -> Samplitude Professional v11.1 -> FLAC/16
source: (FOB) Nakamichi 700 -> Cassette Master (Sony TC-D5M/Dolby B/Maxell XLII-S90)

ai_review.summary: Top‑notch sound captures a high‑energy set featuring smoking versions of The Other One, Ship of Fools, Shakedown Street and an unforgettable LLR.
ai_review.review: Both reviewers rave about the performance, highlighting The Other One, Ship of Fools, Shakedown Street and a standout LLR as among the best ever heard. The recording is described as top‑notch throughout, with ambient crowd dialogue that adds an immersive, you‑are‑there feel while still delivering crystal‑clear audio.

ai_rating.rationale: Two consistent 5‑star reviews praise both the musical performance (high energy, standout songs) and the technical quality (excellent clarity), giving a strong combined rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Sound quality is described as top‑notch throughout; ambient dialogue from the audience adds immersion without detracting from clarity.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Strong set with seamless transitions; reviewers note the show builds and sustains high momentum.

band_member_comments.Keys: Brent (keys) throws a surprise verse on Shakedown Street, adding a unique curveball.
